{"id":2017874340,"question_id":3742,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1780207922,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2017874340/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Number of Items From Sale I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int n;\n    vector<int>freecopies;\n    vector<vector<int>>dp;\n\n    int byrec(vector<vector<int>>& items , int budget , int i)\n    {\n        if(i >= n) return 0;\n        if(dp[i][budget] != -1) return dp[i][budget];\n\n        int ans = 0;\n\n        int price = items[i][1];\n\n        //take \n        if(budget >= price)\n        {\n            for(int purchase = 1 ; (purchase * price) <= budget ; purchase++)\n            {\n                int take = purchase + freecopies[i] + byrec(items , budget - (purchase * price) , i+1);\n                ans = max(ans , take);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // dont take\n        int dont_take = byrec(items , budget , i+1);\n        ans = max(ans , dont_take);\n\n        return dp[i][budget] = ans;\n    }\n\n    int maximumSaleItems(vector<vector<int>>& items, int budget) {\n        n = items.size();\n\n        freecopies.assign(n , 0);\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0 ; j<n ; j++)\n            {\n                int factor = items[j][0];\n\n                if(i != j and (factor % items[i][0] == 0)) freecopies[i]++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        dp.assign(n+1 , vector<int>(budget + 1 , -1));\n    \n        return byrec(items , budget , 0);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-number-of-items-from-sale-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2043}
